integrity: A direct proof is included. Literature comparisons were made against the accessible full-text preprints identified in source_ids and bounded semantic searches. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to finite simple nonempty 3-uniform hypergraphs that are pairwise intersecting. It does not classify higher uniformities, non-intersecting systems, or positive degrees of smaller faces.
title: Rigidity of intersecting triple systems at positive pair codegree three
